text: Never mind, Tom, I’ll get you another brood to-morrow.” “If you do, Mr. Robson, I shall kill them too,” said I. “Humph!” replied he, and having honoured me with a broad stare—which, contrary to his expectations, I sustained without flinching—he turned away with an air of supreme contempt, and stalked into the house. Tom next went to tell his mamma. It was not her way to say much on any subject; but, when she next saw me, her aspect and demeanour were doubly dark and chilled.
